notes.title: Patch v1.1.0.0 Now Live!
notes.notes:
This release adds a new feature! XInput support and rumble has been added to the Windows version of Mute Crimson+! Of course, if you do not like rumble there is a button in the controls menu to toggle it off.

This release also includes various small fixes and tweaks, including fixes aimed at solving some Mac users startup crashes.

http://i.imgur.com/x0QzFyu.png
